description: An address's transactions, newest first (unconfirmed first), with the amount each one moved for the address and the price at the time (USD unless currency is given). Without filters, pages by number; with any filter (block or time range, direction), pages by cursor: pass next_cursor back until it's null (a short page with a cursor isn't the end).

currency.description: Optional: prices in this currency instead of USD.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; it carries the filters.

direction.description: in: the balance went up; out: it went down (a payment with change counts once, as out). Default both.

from_time.description: Start (a date means from its first second): unix seconds, a date like 2025-12-31 (UTC) or a timestamp like 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z.

network.description: Network: BTC, LTC, DOGE, ZEC, BTCTEST, LTCTEST, DOGETEST or ZECTEST.

to_time.description: End (a date means to its last second): unix seconds, a date like 2025-12-31 (UTC) or a timestamp like 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z.

unconfirmed.description: Mempool transactions. Default include, or exclude when there's an end (to_height or to_time).

name: get_transactions
title: Address Transactions
